summary.value: Pod Times Square is an affordable Midtown NYC hotel with smart rooms, free Wi-Fi, walking tours and a prime location near Broadway, at 400 W 42nd St. It suits solo travelers and couples who will be out all day; Trip.com guests say “The location is fantastic!” and “The room was cleaned daily at 10 AM and was very tidy”. Honest watch-outs: “The room was a little small”, and there's a nightly resort fee of $29.84 collected at the front desk.

description.value: Pod Times Square is an affordable Midtown NYC hotel with smart rooms, free Wi-Fi, walking tours and a prime location near Broadway. The hotel is at 400 W 42nd St. Its compact rooms suit travelers who plan to spend most of the day out in the city. Representative Trip.com praise (guest reviews): “The room was cleaned daily at 10 AM and was very tidy”; “The location is fantastic!”. Representative watch-outs: “there's a nightly resort fee of $29.84 collected at the front desk”; “The room was a little small”.
